title: codebase dating profile
caption:
swiping through codebases, so you don't have to.

green flags: tests that pass on purpose, commits that say why, one setup command.
red flags: utils2_final.py, a 900-line handle(), every test skipped,
and the dev who built it left no forwarding address.

what's the biggest red flag you've found in a codebase?

red flags: the dev who built it left

slide.kicker: I inherit red flags. I hand back green ones.
